background_initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished landscape background illustration for a Touhou Project inspired bullet-hell action game's main menu, 16:9 composition, 1920x1080 or larger. Create a bold, unmistakably Gensokyo shrine-night atmosphere rather than a generic beige Japanese stationery UI. A vermilion torii and shrine roof on the RIGHT half under a huge luminous ivory full moon, deep midnight indigo and violet sky, red maple leaves carried through the air, hanging shide paper streamers, a few glowing ofuda talismans, graceful arcs of tiny ruby and icy cyan danmaku lights around the moon, mist over low mountain silhouettes. Anime game title-screen illustration with refined ink edges, strong flat shapes, screen-printed paper grain and luminous accents. Composition: LEFT 37 percent is calm dark blue-violet negative space for a vertical menu, with very little detail and NO bright objects; the principal torii, moon and bullet arcs stay in right 63 percent. Bottom-left also quiet. Strong scarlet/ivory/indigo/cyan palette, striking but controlled, legible menu overlay. No characters, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no interface buttons, no imitation calligraphy. Full-bleed finished illustration.
background_refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Touhou-inspired shrine moonlit menu background. Keep the 16:9 composition, torii on right, quiet left 37 percent for menu, same landscape and hand-painted print texture. Refine this into a more restrained finished game UI background while keeping clear Touhou Project atmosphere. Reduce the red and cyan glowing danmaku dots by about 75 percent, leaving just two delicate sparse curved arcs near the moon. Remove the scattered foreground red leaves from the LEFT menu area; keep a few leaves near the torii. Reduce the moon glow and overall saturation slightly; shift the reds from bright scarlet to muted cinnabar, keep midnight indigo and warm ivory. No excessive magical glow or dense sparkling dots. Keep the shrine recognizable and the night feeling poetic, clean and calm. Do not add characters, lettering, logos, UI controls or extra objects.
seal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT game UI ornament, an original Touhou Project inspired spell-card barrier seal. One perfectly circular emblem centered in a square composition, isolated on transparent background. A crisp ivory and cinnabar-red yin-yang in the center, concentric rings of scarlet ritual lines, exactly balanced tiny diamond and star marks, six small ofuda-shaped tabs around the ring with abstract red geometric marks (NOT letters), fine ivory secondary ring lines with a few pale icy-cyan star points. Japanese anime bullet-hell ritual aesthetic, bold clean screen-printed linework, almost vector-like, slightly textured ink edges, no glossy metal, no bevel, no 3D, NO huge glow. Open spaces between rings must be transparent. Keep all ornament within the central 90% of canvas. High-quality reusable flat UI emblem readable at 64-240 pixels. No text, no logo, no watermark, no background scene.
